SELECT DISTINCT
  lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME,
  lso.SUBJECT_TITLE AS COURSE_TITLE,
  COUNT(lrc.CATALOG_ISBN) OVER (
    PARTITION BY lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE
  ) AS AMOUNT_OF_MATERIAL
FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd
JOIN LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR lci
  ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso
  ON lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG lrc
  ON lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY;

SELECT DISTINCT
    r.ROOM_FULL_NAME AS full_room_name,
    b.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
    b.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS AS street_address,
    a.CITY AS city,
    a.STATE AS state,
    a.POSTAL_CODE AS postal_code,
    fb.BUILDING_HEIGHT AS building_height
FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r
    ON c.MEET_PLACE = r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY
JOIN BUILDINGS b
    ON b.BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb
    ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS a
    ON a.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'
  AND a.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
  AND r.ROOM_FULL_NAME IS NOT NULL;

SELECT DISTINCT
    so.TERM_CODE,
    so.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    r.ROOM,
    r.FLOOR,
    b.BUILDING_KEY,
    b.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS,
    ba.CITY,
    ba.STATE,
    ba.POSTAL_CODE,
    so.FORM_TYPE,
    so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS
FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so
JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS r
    ON r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = so.MEET_PLACE
JOIN BUILDINGS AS b
    ON b.BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS AS ba
    ON ba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
   AND ba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
WHERE so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 300;

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS total_distinct_subjects,
  SUM(d.FEE) AS total_fee_sum,
  MIN(
    TIMESTAMPDIFF(
      MINUTE,
      STR_TO_DATE(s.SESSION_START_TIME, '%h%i%p'),
      CASE
        WHEN STR_TO_DATE(s.SESSION_START_TIME, '%h%i%p') > STR_TO_DATE(s.SESSION_END_TIME, '%h%i%p')
          THEN STR_TO_DATE('1200PM', '%h%i%p')
        ELSE STR_TO_DATE(s.SESSION_END_TIME, '%h%i%p')
      END
    )
  ) AS min_session_duration_minutes,
  MAX(
    TIMESTAMPDIFF(
      MINUTE,
      STR_TO_DATE(s.SESSION_START_TIME, '%h%i%p'),
      CASE
        WHEN STR_TO_DATE(s.SESSION_START_TIME, '%h%i%p') > STR_TO_DATE(s.SESSION_END_TIME, '%h%i%p')
          THEN STR_TO_DATE('1200PM', '%h%i%p')
        ELSE STR_TO_DATE(s.SESSION_END_TIME, '%h%i%p')
      END
    )
  ) AS max_session_duration_minutes
FROM IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION s
JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d
  ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
JOIN BUILDINGS b
  ON b.BUILDING_NUMBER <> s.SESSION_LOCATION;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    sd.BUILDING_COMPONENT,
    b.BUILDING_NAME,
    sd.FLOOR_KEY,
    sd.BUILDING_ROOM,
    su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY,
    ssu.MIT_ID,
    ssu.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES,
    sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE
  FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd
  JOIN BUILDINGS b
    ON b.BUILDING_KEY = sd.BUILDING_KEY
  JOIN SPACE_UNIT su
    ON su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY
  JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE ssu
    ON ssu.DEPT_NAMES = su.DLC_KEY
),
component_sqft AS (
  SELECT
    BUILDING_COMPONENT,
    SUM(ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS total_sqft_component
  FROM base
  GROUP BY BUILDING_COMPONENT
)
SELECT
  base.BUILDING_COMPONENT,
  base.BUILDING_NAME,
  cs.total_sqft_component AS total_sqft,
  COUNT(DISTINCT base.FLOOR_KEY) AS total_distinct_floors,
  COUNT(DISTINCT base.BUILDING_ROOM) AS total_distinct_rooms,
  COUNT(DISTINCT base.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS total_distinct_facility_organizations,
  COUNT(DISTINCT base.MIT_ID) AS total_distinct_supervisors,
  SUM(base.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS total_supervisees
FROM base
JOIN component_sqft cs
  ON cs.BUILDING_COMPONENT = base.BUILDING_COMPONENT
GROUP BY
  base.BUILDING_COMPONENT,
  base.BUILDING_NAME,
  cs.total_sqft_component
ORDER BY
  base.BUILDING_COMPONENT,
  base.BUILDING_NAME;

SELECT
  t.TERM_CODE,
  t.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  CASE
    WHEN t.ACADEMIC_YEAR = CAST(YEAR(CURDATE()) AS CHAR)
         AND COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN p.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) = 1
    THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N'
  END AS CURRENT_TERM_INDICATOR,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS DISTINCT_CIS_SUBJECTS_OFFERED
FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t
LEFT JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER p
  ON p.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE
LEFT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c
  ON c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = t.ACADEMIC_YEAR
 AND (
      (RIGHT(t.TERM_CODE, 2) = 'FA' AND c.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y')
   OR (RIGHT(t.TERM_CODE, 2) = 'JA' AND c.IS_OFFERED_IAP = 'Y')
   OR (RIGHT(t.TERM_CODE, 2) = 'SP' AND c.IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM = 'Y')
   OR (RIGHT(t.TERM_CODE, 2) = 'SU' AND c.IS_OFFERED_SUMMER_TERM = 'Y')
 )
GROUP BY
  t.TERM_CODE,
  t.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  CASE
    WHEN t.ACADEMIC_YEAR = CAST(YEAR(CURDATE()) AS CHAR)
         AND COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN p.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) = 1
    THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N'
  END;

SELECT
    at.TERM_CODE,
    at.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
    at.IS_CURRENT_TERM,
    COUNT(DISTINCT tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS distinct_tip_subjects_offered_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT tm.ISBN) AS distinct_materials_count,
    MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled_students,
    MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrolled_students,
    COUNT(DISTINCT tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) AS distinct_schools_count,
    COALESCE(SUM(td.RECORD_COUNT), 0) AS total_record_count
FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL at
LEFT JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso
    ON at.TERM_CODE = tso.TERM_CODE
LEFT JOIN TIP_DETAIL td
    ON tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
LEFT JOIN TIP_MATERIAL tm
    ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
LEFT JOIN TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS tms
    ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
GROUP BY
    at.TERM_CODE,
    at.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
    at.IS_CURRENT_TERM
ORDER BY
    at.TERM_CODE;

SELECT
  t.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS term_description,
  c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC AS attribute_description,
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name,
  d.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS distinct_subjects_offered_in_term_h_group
FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
JOIN CIS_HASS_ATTRIBUTE a
  ON a.HASS_ATTRIBUTE = c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE
JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d
  ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE
JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t
  ON t.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE
WHERE a.CIS_ATTRIBUTE_GROUP = 'H'
GROUP BY
  t.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC,
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  d.SCHOOL_NAME
ORDER BY
  t.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC,
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  d.SCHOOL_NAME;

SELECT
  lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_CODE,
  lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS,
  lso.TERM_CODE,
  ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  COUNT(DISTINCT lso.COURSE_NUMBER) AS distinct_courses,
  COUNT(DISTINCT lrc.CATALOG_SYSTEM_NUMBER) AS distinct_materials,
  COUNT(DISTINCT lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE) AS distinct_departments,
  COUNT(DISTINCT lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) AS distinct_schools,
  COUNT(DISTINCT lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME) AS distinct_instructors
FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd
JOIN LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS lms
  ON lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso
  ON lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata
  ON ata.TERM_CODE = lso.TERM_CODE
JOIN LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR lci
  ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG lrc
  ON lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
GROUP BY
  lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_CODE,
  lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS,
  lso.TERM_CODE,
  ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION
ORDER BY
  lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_CODE,
  lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS,
  lso.TERM_CODE,
  ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION;

WITH lists_10 AS (
  SELECT
    mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  FROM MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld
  GROUP BY mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT LOWER(mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER)) = 10
),
list_faculty AS (
  SELECT
    mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    ed.MIT_ID AS faculty_mit_id
  FROM MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld
  JOIN lists_10 l10
    ON l10.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY ed
    ON LOWER(ed.KRB_NAME) = LOWER(mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER)
  JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
    ON c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = ed.MIT_ID
   AND c.TERM_CODE = '2023FA'
  GROUP BY
    mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    ed.MIT_ID
),
faculty_title_counts AS (
  SELECT
    lf.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    lf.faculty_mit_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS distinct_titles
  FROM list_faculty lf
  JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
    ON c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = lf.faculty_mit_id
   AND c.TERM_CODE = '2023FA'
  GROUP BY
    lf.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    lf.faculty_mit_id
)
SELECT
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ftc.faculty_mit_id) AS distinct_responsible_faculty_members,
  COALESCE(SUM(ftc.distinct_titles), 0) AS sum_distinct_course_titles_across_faculty
FROM lists_10 l10
JOIN MOIRA_LIST ml
  ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = l10.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
LEFT JOIN faculty_title_counts ftc
  ON ftc.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = l10.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
GROUP BY
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME
ORDER BY
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME;

WITH building_floor_levels AS (
  SELECT
    r.BUILDING_KEY,
    MIN(CAST(f.LEVEL_ID AS SIGNED)) AS min_level,
    MAX(CAST(f.LEVEL_ID AS SIGNED)) AS max_level
  FROM FAC_ROOMS r
  JOIN FAC_FLOOR f
    ON f.FLOOR_KEY = r.FLOOR_KEY
  WHERE f.LEVEL_ID REGEXP '^-?[0-9]+$'
  GROUP BY r.BUILDING_KEY
),
building_floor_counts AS (
  SELECT
    BUILDING_KEY,
    (max_level - min_level + 1) AS floor_count
  FROM building_floor_levels
),
max_floor_buildings AS (
  SELECT bfc.BUILDING_KEY
  FROM building_floor_counts bfc
  WHERE bfc.floor_count = (SELECT MAX(floor_count) FROM building_floor_counts)
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  fb.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS mailing_list_name
FROM max_floor_buildings mfb
JOIN FAC_BUILDING fb
  ON fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = mfb.BUILDING_KEY
JOIN FAC_ROOMS r
  ON r.BUILDING_KEY = fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY ed
  ON ed.OFFICE_LOCATION = r.FAC_ROOM_KEY
JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld
  ON LOWER(mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) = LOWER(ed.KRB_NAME)
JOIN MOIRA_LIST ml
  ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
WHERE ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME LIKE 'a%'
  AND UPPER(ed.KRB_NAME) LIKE 'C%'
ORDER BY building_name, mailing_list_name;

SELECT
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS group_name,
  mlo.OWNER AS owner,
  mlo.OWNER_TYPE AS owner_type,
  CASE
    WHEN ml.IS_PUBLIC = 'Y' THEN 'Public Members'
    WHEN ml.IS_PUBLIC = 'N' THEN 'Hidden Members'
    ELSE 'Hidden Members'
  END AS member_visibility,
  COUNT(DISTINCT mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) AS distinct_member_count
FROM MOIRA_LIST ml
JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld
  ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
LEFT JOIN MOIRA_LIST_OWNER mlo
  ON mlo.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY
WHERE ml.IS_MOIRA_GROUP = 'Y'
  AND UPPER(ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME) LIKE 'B%'
GROUP BY
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
  mlo.OWNER,
  mlo.OWNER_TYPE,
  CASE
    WHEN ml.IS_PUBLIC = 'Y' THEN 'Public Members'
    WHEN ml.IS_PUBLIC = 'N' THEN 'Hidden Members'
    ELSE 'Hidden Members'
  END
WITH ROLLUP
HAVING
  (
    (GROUPING(ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME) = 0 AND COUNT(DISTINCT mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) > 0)
    OR GROUPING(ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME) = 1
  )
ORDER BY
  group_name,
  member_visibility;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG AS building_name,
    b.OWNERSHIP_TYPE     AS ownership_type,
    f.FLOOR              AS floor_number,
    r.BUILDING_ROOM      AS room_number,
    o.ORGANIZATION_NAME  AS organization_name,
    r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY      AS room_key,
    r.AREA               AS area
  FROM FCLT_ROOMS r
  JOIN FCLT_FLOOR f
    ON f.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY = r.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY
  JOIN FCLT_BUILDING b
    ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = f.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
  LEFT JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o
    ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY
  WHERE b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG) <> ''
),
overall AS (
  SELECT SUM(area) AS overall_area
  FROM base
),
building_totals AS (
  SELECT
    building_name,
    ownership_type,
    SUM(area) AS building_area
  FROM base
  GROUP BY building_name, ownership_type
),
rolled AS (
  SELECT
    building_name,
    ownership_type,
    floor_number,
    room_number,
    organization_name,
    COUNT(room_key) AS num_rooms,
    SUM(area) AS total_area
  FROM base
  GROUP BY building_name, ownership_type, floor_number, room_number, organization_name WITH ROLLUP
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN r.building_name IS NULL AND r.ownership_type IS NULL AND r.floor_number IS NULL AND r.room_number IS NULL AND r.organization_name IS NULL
      THEN ''
    ELSE COALESCE(r.building_name, '')
  END AS building_name,
  CASE
    WHEN r.building_name IS NULL AND r.ownership_type IS NULL AND r.floor_number IS NULL AND r.room_number IS NULL AND r.organization_name IS NULL
      THEN ''
    ELSE COALESCE(r.floor_number, '')
  END AS floor_number,
  CASE
    WHEN r.building_name IS NULL AND r.ownership_type IS NULL AND r.floor_number IS NULL AND r.room_number IS NULL AND r.organization_name IS NULL
      THEN ''
    ELSE COALESCE(r.room_number, '')
  END AS room_number,
  CASE
    WHEN r.building_name IS NULL AND r.ownership_type IS NULL AND r.floor_number IS NULL AND r.room_number IS NULL AND r.organization_name IS NULL
      THEN ''
    ELSE COALESCE(r.ownership_type, '')
  END AS ownership_type,
  CASE
    WHEN r.building_name IS NULL AND r.ownership_type IS NULL AND r.floor_number IS NULL AND r.room_number IS NULL AND r.organization_name IS NULL
      THEN ''
    ELSE COALESCE(r.organization_name, '')
  END AS organization_name,
  r.num_rooms,
  r.total_area,
  CASE
    WHEN r.building_name IS NULL AND r.ownership_type IS NULL AND r.floor_number IS NULL AND r.room_number IS NULL AND r.organization_name IS NULL
      THEN 100.0
    WHEN r.building_name IS NOT NULL AND r.floor_number IS NULL
      THEN (r.total_area / ovr.overall_area) * 100.0
    WHEN r.building_name IS NOT NULL AND r.floor_number IS NOT NULL
      THEN (r.total_area / bt.building_area) * 100.0
    ELSE NULL
  END AS pct_of_total_area
FROM rolled r
CROSS JOIN overall ovr
LEFT JOIN building_totals bt
  ON bt.building_name = r.building_name
 AND bt.ownership_type = r.ownership_type
ORDER BY
  CASE
    WHEN r.building_name IS NULL AND r.ownership_type IS NULL AND r.floor_number IS NULL AND r.room_number IS NULL AND r.organization_name IS NULL
      THEN 0
    ELSE 1
  END,
  r.building_name,
  CAST(r.floor_number AS UNSIGNED),
  r.room_number;

WITH
b AS (
  SELECT
    FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,
    CAMPUS_SECTOR,
    BUILDING_NAME_LONG,
    OWNERSHIP_TYPE
  FROM FCLT_BUILDING
  WHERE CAMPUS_SECTOR IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(CAMPUS_SECTOR) <> ''
),
addr AS (
  SELECT
    FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,
    MAX(CITY)  AS CITY,
    MAX(STATE) AS STATE
  FROM FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS
  GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
),
floors AS (
  SELECT
    FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,
    COUNT(DISTINCT FLOOR) AS floor_cnt
  FROM FCLT_FLOOR
  GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
),
rooms AS (
  SELECT
    FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,
    COUNT(*) AS room_cnt,
    COUNT(DISTINCT FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_cnt
  FROM FCLT_ROOMS
  GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    b.CAMPUS_SECTOR,
    b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,
    b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG,
    a.CITY,
    a.STATE,
    b.OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
    COALESCE(f.floor_cnt, 0) AS floor_cnt,
    ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(fl.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, 0)), 0) AS assignable_area_sum,
    COALESCE(r.room_cnt, 0) AS room_cnt,
    COALESCE(r.org_cnt, 0) AS org_cnt
  FROM b
  LEFT JOIN addr a
    ON a.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
  LEFT JOIN floors f
    ON f.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
  LEFT JOIN rooms r
    ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
  LEFT JOIN FCLT_FLOOR fl
    ON fl.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
  LEFT JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS ba
    ON ba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
  GROUP BY
    b.CAMPUS_SECTOR,
    b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,
    b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG,
    a.CITY,
    a.STATE,
    b.OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
    f.floor_cnt,
    r.room_cnt,
    r.org_cnt
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    CAMPUS_SECTOR,
    BUILDING_NAME_LONG,
    CITY,
    STATE,
    OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
    floor_cnt,
    assignable_area_sum,
    room_cnt,
    org_cnt,
    (DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY CAMPUS_SECTOR ORDER BY assignable_area_sum DESC) - 1) AS rnk
  FROM base
),
sector_rollup AS (
  SELECT
    CAMPUS_SECTOR,
    NULL AS BUILDING_NAME_LONG,
    NULL AS CITY,
    NULL AS STATE,
    NULL AS OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
    SUM(floor_cnt) AS floor_cnt,
    ROUND(SUM(assignable_area_sum), 0) AS assignable_area_sum,
    NULL AS room_cnt,
    NULL AS org_cnt,
    NULL AS rnk
  FROM base
  GROUP BY CAMPUS_SECTOR WITH ROLLUP
),
sector_totals AS (
  SELECT
    CAMPUS_SECTOR,
    floor_cnt,
    assignable_area_sum
  FROM sector_rollup
  WHERE CAMPUS_SECTOR IS NOT NULL
),
grand_total AS (
  SELECT
    NULL AS CAMPUS_SECTOR,
    NULL AS BUILDING_NAME_LONG,
    NULL AS CITY,
    NULL AS STATE,
    NULL AS OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
    SUM(floor_cnt) AS floor_cnt,
    ROUND(SUM(assignable_area_sum), 0) AS assignable_area_sum,
    NULL AS room_cnt,
    NULL AS org_cnt,
    NULL AS rnk
  FROM sector_totals
)
SELECT
  CAMPUS_SECTOR,
  BUILDING_NAME_LONG,
  CITY,
  STATE,
  OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
  floor_cnt AS distinct_floor_count,
  assignable_area_sum AS total_assignable_area_no_decimals,
  room_cnt AS total_room_count,
  org_cnt AS distinct_organization_count,
  rnk AS rank_in_sector_by_assignable_area
FROM ranked

UNION ALL

SELECT
  CAMPUS_SECTOR,
  BUILDING_NAME_LONG,
  CITY,
  STATE,
  OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
  floor_cnt AS distinct_floor_count,
  assignable_area_sum AS total_assignable_area_no_decimals,
  room_cnt AS total_room_count,
  org_cnt AS distinct_organization_count,
  rnk AS rank_in_sector_by_assignable_area
FROM sector_rollup
WHERE CAMPUS_SECTOR IS NOT NULL

UNION ALL

SELECT
  CAMPUS_SECTOR,
  BUILDING_NAME_LONG,
  CITY,
  STATE,
  OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
  floor_cnt AS distinct_floor_count,
  assignable_area_sum AS total_assignable_area_no_decimals,
  room_cnt AS total_room_count,
  org_cnt AS distinct_organization_count,
  rnk AS rank_in_sector_by_assignable_area
FROM grand_total

ORDER BY
  (CAMPUS_SECTOR IS NULL) ASC,
  CAMPUS_SECTOR,
  (rank_in_sector_by_assignable_area IS NULL) ASC,
  rank_in_sector_by_assignable_area,
  BUILDING_NAME_LONG;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    fb.BUILDING_NUMBER,
    fb.BUILDING_NAME_LONG AS FULL_NAME,
    b.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS AS STREET_ADDRESS,
    fb.BUILDING_TYPE,
    fb.DATE_OCCUPIED AS OCCUPANCY_DATE,
    fb.OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
    fb.SITE
  FROM FAC_BUILDING fb
  JOIN FAC_BUILDING_ADDRESS fba
    ON fba.BUILDING_KEY = fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
   AND fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
  JOIN BUILDINGS b
    ON b.BUILDING_KEY = fba.BUILDING_KEY
  WHERE fb.PARENT_BUILDING_NUMBER IS NULL
)
SELECT
  BUILDING_NUMBER,
  FULL_NAME,
  STREET_ADDRESS,
  BUILDING_TYPE,
  OCCUPANCY_DATE,
  OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
  SITE
FROM base

UNION ALL

SELECT
  NULL AS BUILDING_NUMBER,
  'MIT OWNED COUNT' AS FULL_NAME,
  NULL AS STREET_ADDRESS,
  NULL AS BUILDING_TYPE,
  NULL AS OCCUPANCY_DATE,
  NULL AS OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
  CAST(COUNT(*) AS CHAR) AS SITE
FROM base
WHERE SITE = 'MIT' AND OWNERSHIP_TYPE = 'OWNED'

UNION ALL

SELECT
  NULL AS BUILDING_NUMBER,
  'MIT LEASED COUNT' AS FULL_NAME,
  NULL AS STREET_ADDRESS,
  NULL AS BUILDING_TYPE,
  NULL AS OCCUPANCY_DATE,
  NULL AS OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
  CAST(COUNT(*) AS CHAR) AS SITE
FROM base
WHERE SITE = 'MIT' AND OWNERSHIP_TYPE = 'LEASED'

UNION ALL

SELECT
  NULL AS BUILDING_NUMBER,
  'MIT TOTAL COUNT' AS FULL_NAME,
  NULL AS STREET_ADDRESS,
  NULL AS BUILDING_TYPE,
  NULL AS OCCUPANCY_DATE,
  NULL AS OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
  CAST(COUNT(*) AS CHAR) AS SITE
FROM base
WHERE SITE = 'MIT';

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    b.BUILDING_NUMBER AS building_number,
    CASE
      WHEN STR_TO_DATE(b.DATE_BUILT, '%m/%d/%Y') IS NOT NULL THEN DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(b.DATE_BUILT, '%m/%d/%Y'), '%Y')
      ELSE 'UNKNOWN'
    END AS construction_year,
    CASE
      WHEN STR_TO_DATE(b.DATE_OCCUPIED, '%m/%d/%Y') IS NOT NULL THEN DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(b.DATE_OCCUPIED, '%m/%d/%Y'), '%Y')
      ELSE 'UNKNOWN'
    END AS occupancy_year,
    CASE
      WHEN STR_TO_DATE(b.DATE_BUILT, '%m/%d/%Y') IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(b.DATE_BUILT, '%m/%d/%Y'), '%Y') AS UNSIGNED)
      ELSE 9999
    END AS construction_year_sort
  FROM FAC_BUILDING b
  WHERE b.OWNERSHIP_TYPE = 'OWNED'
    AND (b.PARENT_BUILDING_NUMBER IS NULL OR TRIM(CAST(b.PARENT_BUILDING_NUMBER AS CHAR)) = '')
),
detail AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN @prev_year = construction_year THEN ''
      ELSE construction_year
    END AS construction_start_year,
    building_number,
    occupancy_year AS initial_occupancy_year,
    @prev_year := construction_year AS _set_prev_year,
    construction_year_sort
  FROM (
    SELECT *
    FROM base
    ORDER BY construction_year_sort, construction_year, building_number
  ) s
  CROSS JOIN (SELECT @prev_year := NULL) vars
)
SELECT
  construction_start_year,
  building_number,
  initial_occupancy_year
FROM (
  SELECT
    construction_start_year,
    building_number,
    initial_occupancy_year,
    construction_year_sort,
    0 AS is_summary
  FROM detail
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    '' AS construction_start_year,
    CONCAT(COUNT(*), ' Buildings') AS building_number,
    '' AS initial_occupancy_year,
    10000 AS construction_year_sort,
    1 AS is_summary
  FROM base
) x
ORDER BY is_summary, construction_year_sort, building_number;

WITH latest_bldg AS (
  SELECT b.*
  FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST b
  JOIN (
    SELECT FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, MAX(FISCAL_PERIOD) AS max_fiscal_period
    FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST
    WHERE SITE = 'MIT'
    GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
  ) m
    ON m.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
   AND m.max_fiscal_period = b.FISCAL_PERIOD
  WHERE b.SITE = 'MIT'
),
bldg_base AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN OWNERSHIP_TYPE IS NULL OR BUILDING_USE IS NULL THEN 'UNKNOWN'
      ELSE OWNERSHIP_TYPE
    END AS ownership_type,
    CASE
      WHEN OWNERSHIP_TYPE IS NULL OR BUILDING_USE IS NULL THEN 'UNKNOWN'
      ELSE BUILDING_USE
    END AS usage_type,
    COALESCE(PARENT_BUILDING_NUMBER, FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) AS bldg_group_id,
    EXT_GROSS_AREA,
    FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
  FROM latest_bldg
),
bldg_agg AS (
  SELECT
    ownership_type,
    usage_type,
    COUNT(DISTINCT bldg_group_id) AS distinct_buildings,
    SUM(EXT_GROSS_AREA) AS total_gross_sqft
  FROM bldg_base
  GROUP BY ownership_type, usage_type
),
room_org_agg AS (
  SELECT
    bb.ownership_type,
    bb.usage_type,
    COUNT(DISTINCT r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS distinct_rooms,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS distinct_organizations
  FROM bldg_base bb
  LEFT JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r
    ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = bb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
  LEFT JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o
    ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY
  GROUP BY bb.ownership_type, bb.usage_type
),
final_rows AS (
  SELECT
    a.ownership_type,
    a.usage_type,
    a.distinct_buildings,
    a.total_gross_sqft,
    COALESCE(ro.distinct_rooms, 0) AS distinct_rooms,
    COALESCE(ro.distinct_organizations, 0) AS distinct_organizations
  FROM bldg_agg a
  LEFT JOIN room_org_agg ro
    ON ro.ownership_type = a.ownership_type
   AND ro.usage_type = a.usage_type
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ownership_type ORDER BY usage_type) = 1
      THEN ownership_type
    ELSE NULL
  END AS ownership_type,
  usage_type,
  distinct_buildings,
  total_gross_sqft,
  distinct_rooms,
  distinct_organizations
FROM final_rows
ORDER BY ownership_type DESC, usage_type;

SELECT
  'TOTAL' AS parent_building_number,
  NULL AS building_use,
  SUM(b.EXT_GROSS_AREA) AS total_gross_sqft
FROM FCLT_BUILDING b

UNION ALL

SELECT
  b.PARENT_BUILDING_NUMBER AS parent_building_number,
  b.BUILDING_USE AS building_use,
  SUM(b.EXT_GROSS_AREA) AS total_gross_sqft
FROM FCLT_BUILDING b
WHERE b.BUILDING_USE IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  b.PARENT_BUILDING_NUMBER,
  b.BUILDING_USE
ORDER BY
  CASE WHEN parent_building_number = 'TOTAL' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
  parent_building_number,
  building_use;

SELECT
    o.ORGANIZATION_ID AS organization_id,
    o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER AS organization_number,
    o.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL AS organization_level,
    CASE
        WHEN o.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL IN ('2','3','4','5','6') THEN CONCAT(' ', o.ORGANIZATION_NAME)
        ELSE o.ORGANIZATION_NAME
    END AS organization_name_formatted,
    CASE
        WHEN o.ASSIGNABLE = '1' THEN 'ASSIGNABLE'
        ELSE 'NON-ASSIGNABLE'
    END AS assignable_label,
    FORMAT(COALESCE(SUM(r.AREA), 0), 0) AS total_room_area,
    FORMAT(COUNT(r.ROOM), 0) AS room_count,
    FORMAT(COALESCE(AVG(r.AREA), 0), 0) AS avg_room_area
FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION o
LEFT JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r
    ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY
WHERE o.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST'
GROUP BY
    o.ORGANIZATION_ID,
    o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER,
    o.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL,
    o.ORGANIZATION_NAME,
    o.ASSIGNABLE
ORDER BY
    o.ORGANIZATION_ID;

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN mu.ASSIGNABLE = '1' THEN 'Assignable'
    WHEN mu.ASSIGNABLE = '0' THEN 'Non-assignable'
    ELSE mu.ASSIGNABLE
  END AS room_category,
  CASE
    WHEN GROUPING(mu.DESCRIPTION) = 1 THEN 'Subtotal'
    ELSE mu.DESCRIPTION
  END AS major_use_description,
  COUNT(*) AS total_rooms,
  SUM(r.AREA) AS total_area,
  AVG(r.AREA) AS avg_room_area
FROM FCLT_ROOMS r
JOIN FCLT_MAJOR_USE mu
  ON r.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = mu.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY
WHERE mu.MAJOR_USE NOT LIKE 'ZUSE%'
  AND mu.DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE 'ZUSE%'
GROUP BY mu.ASSIGNABLE, mu.DESCRIPTION WITH ROLLUP
HAVING GROUPING(mu.ASSIGNABLE) = 0
ORDER BY
  mu.ASSIGNABLE,
  GROUPING(mu.DESCRIPTION),
  mu.DESCRIPTION;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    fr.FLOOR_KEY,
    fr.FLOOR,
    ff.FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE,
    fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS department_name,
    fr.FAC_ROOM_KEY,
    CAST(fr.AREA AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS area
  FROM BUILDINGS b
  JOIN FAC_ROOMS fr
    ON b.BUILDING_KEY = fr.BUILDING_KEY
  LEFT JOIN FAC_FLOOR ff
    ON ff.FLOOR_KEY = fr.FLOOR_KEY
  LEFT JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo
    ON fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fr.ORGANIZATION_KEY
  WHERE b.BUILDING_NAME = 'Ray and Maria Stata Center'
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    FLOOR,
    FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE,
    department_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT FAC_ROOM_KEY) AS room_count,
    SUM(area) AS total_room_area,
    AVG(area) AS avg_room_area
  FROM base
  GROUP BY FLOOR, FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE, department_name

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    FLOOR,
    FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE,
    'Subtotal' AS department_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT FAC_ROOM_KEY) AS room_count,
    SUM(area) AS total_room_area,
    AVG(area) AS avg_room_area
  FROM base
  GROUP BY FLOOR, FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    'Grand Total' AS FLOOR,
    NULL AS FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE,
    'Grand Total' AS department_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT FAC_ROOM_KEY) AS room_count,
    SUM(area) AS total_room_area,
    AVG(area) AS avg_room_area
  FROM base
)
SELECT
  FLOOR,
  department_name,
  room_count,
  total_room_area,
  avg_room_area
FROM agg
ORDER BY
  (FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE IS NULL) ASC,
  FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE ASC,
  FLOOR ASC,
  CASE
    WHEN department_name = 'Subtotal' THEN 1
    WHEN department_name = 'Grand Total' THEN 2
    ELSE 0
  END ASC,
  department_name ASC;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    z.ACCESS_LEVEL AS access_level,
    su2.SPACE_USAGE AS usage_type,
    fo.DLC_NAME AS space_name,
    sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY AS space_unit_key,
    sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE AS area
  FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd
  JOIN SPACE_UNIT su
    ON su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY
  JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo
    ON fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY
  JOIN SPACE_USAGE su2
    ON su2.SPACE_USAGE_KEY = sd.SPACE_USAGE_KEY
  JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD z
    ON z.BUILDING_ROOM = sd.BUILDING_ROOM
   AND z.BUILDING_COMPONENT = sd.BUILDING_COMPONENT
  WHERE sd.BUILDING_KEY = '32'
    AND z.BUILDING_COMPONENT = '32'
    AND UPPER(su2.SPACE_USAGE) NOT LIKE '%STORAGE%'
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    access_level,
    usage_type,
    space_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT space_unit_key) AS distinct_spaces,
    SUM(area) AS total_area,
    AVG(area) AS avg_area,
    GROUPING(access_level) AS g_access,
    GROUPING(usage_type) AS g_usage,
    GROUPING(space_name) AS g_space
  FROM base
  GROUP BY access_level, usage_type, space_name WITH ROLLUP
),
labeled AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN g_access = 1 THEN 'Grand Total'
      WHEN g_usage = 1 THEN access_level
      ELSE access_level
    END AS access_level_label,
    CASE
      WHEN g_access = 1 THEN NULL
      WHEN g_usage = 1 THEN 'Subtotal'
      WHEN g_space = 1 THEN usage_type
      ELSE usage_type
    END AS usage_type_label,
    CASE
      WHEN g_access = 1 THEN NULL
      WHEN g_usage = 1 THEN NULL
      WHEN g_space = 1 THEN 'Subtotal'
      ELSE space_name
    END AS space_name_label,
    distinct_spaces,
    total_area,
    avg_area,
    access_level,
    usage_type,
    space_name,
    g_access, g_usage, g_space
  FROM agg
),
suppressed AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN g_access = 1 THEN access_level_label
      WHEN access_level_label = LAG(access_level_label) OVER (
        ORDER BY
          access_level,
          (g_usage = 1) ASC, usage_type,
          (g_space = 1) ASC, space_name,
          g_access, g_usage, g_space
      ) THEN NULL
      ELSE access_level_label
    END AS access_level,
    CASE
      WHEN g_access = 1 THEN usage_type_label
      WHEN g_usage = 1 THEN usage_type_label
      WHEN usage_type_label = LAG(usage_type_label) OVER (
        PARTITION BY access_level
        ORDER BY
          access_level,
          (g_usage = 1) ASC, usage_type,
          (g_space = 1) ASC, space_name,
          g_access, g_usage, g_space
      ) THEN NULL
      ELSE usage_type_label
    END AS usage_type,
    space_name_label AS space_name,
    FORMAT(distinct_spaces, 0) AS distinct_space_count,
    FORMAT(total_area, 0) AS total_area,
    FORMAT(avg_area, 0) AS avg_area,
    access_level AS access_level_sort,
    usage_type AS usage_type_sort,
    space_name AS space_name_sort,
    g_access, g_usage, g_space
  FROM labeled
)
SELECT
  access_level,
  usage_type,
  space_name,
  distinct_space_count,
  total_area,
  avg_area
FROM suppressed
ORDER BY
  access_level_sort,
  (g_usage = 1) ASC, usage_type_sort,
  (g_space = 1) ASC, space_name_sort,
  g_access, g_usage, g_space;

SELECT
  fo.ORGANIZATION_SORT AS break_group,
  fo.ORGANIZATION_ID AS id,
  fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS name,
  fo.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL AS level,
  fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER AS number,
  CASE
    WHEN hfr.EMERITUS_STATUS IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(hfr.EMERITUS_STATUS) <> '' THEN 'Emeritus'
    ELSE 'Non-Emeritus'
  END AS emeritus_label,
  (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT hfr2.MIT_ID)
    FROM HR_FACULTY_ROSTER hfr2
    WHERE hfr2.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE = hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE
  ) AS distinct_employer_count
FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo
JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY mdh
  ON mdh.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY
JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou
  ON hou.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY
JOIN HR_FACULTY_ROSTER hfr
  ON hfr.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE = hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE
WHERE mdh.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy'
ORDER BY
  fo.ORGANIZATION_SORT,
  fo.ORGANIZATION_ID,
  fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME,
  fo.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL,
  fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER,
  emeritus_label;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    c.SUBJECT_TITLE AS course_name,
    t.TERM_START_DATE AS term_start_date,
    b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG AS building_name,
    b.ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME AS building_access_level,
    r.AREA AS room_assignable_area
  FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
  JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t
    ON t.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE
  JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r
    ON r.BUILDING_ROOM = c.MEET_PLACE
  JOIN FCLT_BUILDING b
    ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
  WHERE c.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL
    AND t.TERM_START_DATE IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  course_name,
  term_start_date,
  building_name,
  building_access_level,
  room_assignable_area,
  LAG(course_name) OVER (ORDER BY term_start_date, course_name) AS previous_course_name,
  LEAD(course_name) OVER (ORDER BY term_start_date, course_name) AS next_course_name
FROM base
ORDER BY term_start_date, course_name;

SELECT DISTINCT
  c.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  c.SUBJECT_TITLE AS course_name,
  b.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
  COUNT(*) OVER (
    PARTITION BY c.ACADEMIC_YEAR
    ORDER BY t.TERM_START_DATE, c.SUBJECT_ID, c.SECTION_ID
    ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
  ) AS running_cumulative_course_count
FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t
  ON c.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE
LEFT JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r
  ON c.MEET_PLACE = r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY
LEFT JOIN FCLT_BUILDING b
  ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
ORDER BY
  c.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  t.TERM_START_DATE,
  c.SUBJECT_ID,
  c.SECTION_ID;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS dept_name,
    tso.MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER AS master_course_code,
    tso.SUBJECT_ID AS subject_id,
    tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE AS new_shelf_price,
    tm.ISBN AS material_isbn
  FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso
  LEFT JOIN TIP_DETAIL td
    ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
  LEFT JOIN TIP_MATERIAL tm
    ON tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    dept_name,
    master_course_code,
    COUNT(DISTINCT subject_id) AS distinct_subjects,
    SUM(COALESCE(new_shelf_price, 0)) AS sum_new_shelf_price,
    COUNT(DISTINCT material_isbn) AS distinct_materials
  FROM base
  GROUP BY dept_name, master_course_code

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    dept_name,
    NULL AS master_course_code,
    COUNT(DISTINCT subject_id) AS distinct_subjects,
    SUM(COALESCE(new_shelf_price, 0)) AS sum_new_shelf_price,
    COUNT(DISTINCT material_isbn) AS distinct_materials
  FROM base
  GROUP BY dept_name

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    NULL AS dept_name,
    NULL AS master_course_code,
    COUNT(DISTINCT subject_id) AS distinct_subjects,
    SUM(COALESCE(new_shelf_price, 0)) AS sum_new_shelf_price,
    COUNT(DISTINCT material_isbn) AS distinct_materials
  FROM base
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(dept_name, 'Grand Total') AS offer_dept_name,
  CASE
    WHEN dept_name IS NOT NULL AND master_course_code IS NULL THEN 'Subtotal'
    WHEN dept_name IS NULL AND master_course_code IS NULL THEN 'Grand Total'
    ELSE master_course_code
  END AS master_course_code,
  FORMAT(distinct_subjects, 0) AS distinct_subject_count,
  FORMAT(sum_new_shelf_price, 0) AS sum_new_shelf_price,
  FORMAT(distinct_materials, 0) AS distinct_tip_material_count
FROM agg
ORDER BY
  CASE WHEN dept_name IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  dept_name,
  CASE WHEN master_course_code IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  master_course_code;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    c.TERM_CODE,
    c.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    c.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    c.SUBJECT_ID,
    CASE
      WHEN c.EQUIVALENT_SUBJECTS IS NULL OR TRIM(c.EQUIVALENT_SUBJECTS) = '' THEN 0
      ELSE 1 + (LENGTH(c.EQUIVALENT_SUBJECTS) - LENGTH(REPLACE(c.EQUIVALENT_SUBJECTS, ',', '')))
    END AS equiv_cnt
  FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
),
dept_dim AS (
  SELECT
    d.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    d.SCHOOL_NAME,
    a.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER
  FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d
  LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a
    ON a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
),
course_level AS (
  SELECT
    b.TERM_CODE,
    b.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    b.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    b.SUBJECT_ID,
    MAX(b.equiv_cnt) AS equiv_cnt
  FROM base b
  GROUP BY
    b.TERM_CODE, b.DEPARTMENT_CODE, b.DEPARTMENT_NAME, b.SUBJECT_ID
),
dept_term AS (
  SELECT
    cl.TERM_CODE,
    cl.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    cl.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cl.SUBJECT_ID) AS distinct_courses_offered,
    AVG(cl.equiv_cnt) AS avg_equivalent_subjects_per_course
  FROM course_level cl
  GROUP BY
    cl.TERM_CODE, cl.DEPARTMENT_CODE, cl.DEPARTMENT_NAME
),
term_subtotal AS (
  SELECT
    dt.TERM_CODE,
    NULL AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    'SUBTOTAL' AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    SUM(dt.distinct_courses_offered) AS distinct_courses_offered,
    AVG(dt.avg_equivalent_subjects_per_course) AS avg_equivalent_subjects_per_course
  FROM dept_term dt
  GROUP BY dt.TERM_CODE
),
overall_total AS (
  SELECT
    NULL AS TERM_CODE,
    NULL AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    'TOTAL' AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    SUM(dt.distinct_courses_offered) AS distinct_courses_offered,
    AVG(dt.avg_equivalent_subjects_per_course) AS avg_equivalent_subjects_per_course
  FROM dept_term dt
)
SELECT
  r.TERM_CODE,
  r.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  r.distinct_courses_offered,
  r.avg_equivalent_subjects_per_course,
  r.SCHOOL_NAME,
  r.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER
FROM (
  SELECT
    dt.TERM_CODE,
    dt.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    dt.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    dt.distinct_courses_offered,
    dt.avg_equivalent_subjects_per_course,
    dd.SCHOOL_NAME,
    dd.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER,
    0 AS sort_group,
    dt.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS sort_dept
  FROM dept_term dt
  LEFT JOIN dept_dim dd
    ON dd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dt.DEPARTMENT_CODE

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    ts.TERM_CODE,
    ts.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    ts.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    ts.distinct_courses_offered,
    ts.avg_equivalent_subjects_per_course,
    NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME,
    NULL AS DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER,
    1 AS sort_group,
    'ZZZ' AS sort_dept
  FROM term_subtotal ts

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    ot.TERM_CODE,
    ot.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    ot.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    ot.distinct_courses_offered,
    ot.avg_equivalent_subjects_per_course,
    NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME,
    NULL AS DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER,
    2 AS sort_group,
    'ZZZ' AS sort_dept
  FROM overall_total ot
) r
ORDER BY
  (r.TERM_CODE IS NULL) ASC,
  r.TERM_CODE ASC,
  r.sort_group ASC,
  r.sort_dept ASC;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN at.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' THEN 'CURRENT' ELSE 'NOT CURRENT' END AS status_label,
    isc.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME AS session_name,
    CASE
      WHEN ss.SESSION_START_TIME REGEXP '^(0[1-9]|1[0-2])[0-5][0-9](AM|PM)$'
       AND ss.SESSION_END_TIME   REGEXP '^(0[1-9]|1[0-2])[0-5][0-9](AM|PM)$'
      THEN GREATEST(
             0,
             TIMESTAMPDIFF(
               MINUTE,
               STR_TO_DATE(ss.SESSION_START_TIME, '%h%i%p'),
               STR_TO_DATE(ss.SESSION_END_TIME,   '%h%i%p')
             )
           )
      ELSE 0
    END AS session_minutes
  FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d
  JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at
    ON d.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE
  JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION ss
    ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = ss.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
  JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY isc
    ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = isc.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    status_label,
    session_name,
    COUNT(*) AS iap_session_count,
    SUM(session_minutes) AS total_session_minutes,
    AVG(session_minutes) AS avg_session_minutes
  FROM base
  GROUP BY status_label, session_name WITH ROLLUP
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN status_label IS NULL AND session_name IS NOT NULL THEN 'TOTAL'
    WHEN status_label IS NOT NULL AND session_name IS NULL THEN status_label
    ELSE status_label
  END AS status_total_label,
  CASE
    WHEN status_label IS NULL AND session_name IS NOT NULL THEN 'TOTAL'
    WHEN status_label IS NOT NULL AND session_name IS NULL THEN 'SUBTOTAL'
    ELSE session_name
  END AS session_name,
  iap_session_count,
  total_session_minutes,
  avg_session_minutes
FROM (
  SELECT
    status_label,
    session_name,
    iap_session_count,
    total_session_minutes,
    avg_session_minutes,
    CASE
      WHEN status_label IS NULL AND session_name IS NOT NULL THEN 2
      WHEN status_label IS NOT NULL AND session_name IS NULL THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS row_type,
    CASE WHEN status_label = 'CURRENT' THEN 0 WHEN status_label = 'NOT CURRENT' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS status_sort
  FROM agg
  WHERE NOT (status_label IS NULL AND session_name IS NULL)
) x
ORDER BY
  status_sort,
  row_type,
  session_name;

WITH term_subject_counts AS (
  SELECT
    t.TERM_CODE,
    t.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS distinct_subjects_in_term
  FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t
  LEFT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
    ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE
  GROUP BY
    t.TERM_CODE,
    t.ACADEMIC_YEAR
),
term_rows AS (
  SELECT
    TERM_CODE,
    CASE
      WHEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY TERM_CODE) = 1
        THEN ACADEMIC_YEAR
      ELSE ''
    END AS academic_year_display,
    distinct_subjects_in_term
  FROM term_subject_counts
)
SELECT
  TERM_CODE AS term_code,
  academic_year_display AS academic_year,
  distinct_subjects_in_term AS distinct_subject_count
FROM term_rows
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'TOTAL' AS term_code,
  '' AS academic_year,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED) AS distinct_subject_count
ORDER BY
  CASE WHEN term_code = 'TOTAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  term_code;

SELECT
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS list_name,
  mlo.OWNER AS owner,
  COUNT(*) AS total_member_count
FROM MOIRA_LIST ml
JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld
  ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
JOIN MOIRA_LIST_OWNER mlo
  ON mlo.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY
LEFT JOIN SE_PERSON sp
  ON LOWER(sp.KRB_NAME) = LOWER(mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER)
LEFT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd
  ON msd.FULL_NAME = sp.FULL_NAME
GROUP BY
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
  mlo.OWNER
HAVING
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME LIKE 'E%'
  AND COUNT(*) BETWEEN 10 AND 20
  AND (
    SUM(CASE WHEN msd.DEPARTMENT = '6' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) /
    NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN sp.KRB_NAME IS NOT NULL AND msd.FULL_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)
  ) > 0.75;

WITH list_totals AS (
  SELECT
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
    ml.IS_PUBLIC,
    COUNT(*) AS total_subscriber_count
  FROM MOIRA_LIST ml
  JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld
    ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  WHERE ml.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST = 'Y'
    AND ml.IS_ACTIVE = 'Y'
  GROUP BY
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
    ml.IS_PUBLIC
),
dept_counts AS (
  SELECT
    mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    COUNT(*) AS dept_student_subscriber_count
  FROM MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld
  JOIN SE_PERSON sp
    ON LOWER(sp.KRB_NAME) = LOWER(mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER)
  JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd
    ON LOWER(msd.FULL_NAME) = LOWER(sp.FULL_NAME)
  JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd
    ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT
  GROUP BY
    mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME
),
dept_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    dc.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY dc.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
      ORDER BY dc.dept_student_subscriber_count DESC, dc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ASC
    ) AS rn
  FROM dept_counts dc
)
SELECT
  lt.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS list_name,
  lt.IS_PUBLIC AS is_public,
  lt.total_subscriber_count,
  dr.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS top_student_department,
  dr.dept_student_subscriber_count AS top_department_student_subscriber_count
FROM list_totals lt
LEFT JOIN dept_ranked dr
  ON dr.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = lt.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
 AND dr.rn = 1
ORDER BY
  lt.total_subscriber_count DESC,
  lt.MOIRA_LIST_NAME ASC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT
  r.ROOM_FULL_NAME,
  mu.MAJOR_USE,
  MAX(CAST(r.AREA AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS max_room_area,
  MAX(o.ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS max_organization_name,
  COUNT(r.FAC_ROOM_KEY) AS number_of_rooms,
  SUM(CAST(r.AREA AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS total_room_area
FROM FAC_ROOMS r
JOIN FAC_MAJOR_USE mu
  ON r.MAJOR_USE_KEY = mu.MAJOR_USE_KEY
JOIN FAC_ORGANIZATION o
  ON r.ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.ORGANIZATION_KEY
WHERE r.BUILDING_KEY = '45'
GROUP BY
  r.ROOM_FULL_NAME,
  mu.MAJOR_USE
ORDER BY
  r.ROOM_FULL_NAME;
